purpose: Separate local closure error from accumulated reduced-state drift in the BC2-C0 enriched prescribed-H dynamics failure, without changing state dimension, flux closures, geometry, forcing or groundwater feedback.

unchanged_model.q90: same source-aligned standard closure as C0
unchanged_model.H_input: same prescribed qualified BC2-A2 Reference H(t)

decomposition.free_branch: Identical to C0 free propagation. The reduced state at interval k begins from the previous reduced end state.
decomposition.teacher_branch: At every observation interval, reconstruct the exact reduced state by conservative projection of the accepted Reference state at the interval start, then propagate exactly one interval with the unchanged C0 model and the same H(t) path.

numerics.method: same iterative Heun structure and theta-based corrector norm as corrected C0
numerics.reason_for_cross_dt: C0 showed 0.0002 may leave the qualified domain for the 2.5-cm moving cases; a smaller cross-step tests numerical convergence without changing the physical model.

per_history_width: RMS and maximum local-closure state error
RMS and maximum total free-propagation state error
RMS and maximum local/state/total interval q90 error
RMS and maximum local/state/total interval qi error
RMS and maximum local/state/total interval qH error
fraction of intervals where |state-induced component| exceeds |local closure component| for each flux
first interval where state-induced component exceeds local component for each flux and total storage

diagnostic_classification.per_history_width_and_channel: Apply the pre_execution_classification_clarification rule independently to state_shape, q90, qi and qH.
diagnostic_classification.overall: No scalar majority vote or aggregate verdict across channels.

next_step_binding.state_shape_drift: If state-shape is drift-dominant while teacher-forced flux errors remain bounded relative to free errors, investigate invariant/manifold stability before changing local closure formulas.
next_step_binding.local_flux_closure: If q90, qi or qH is local-closure-dominant on Reference states, only that identified local channel may be targeted next.
next_step_binding.mixed: If channels disagree, preserve the decomposition and do not replace all closures together.

pre_execution_classification_clarificati.reason: Total storage is structurally conservative and can hide internal redistribution drift, especially WT_HOLD.
diagnostic_channels: state_shape: RMS over all physical reduced-state component errors [9 fixed storages, Wb, Wt]
total unsaturated storage reported separately but not used as sole drift diagnostic
pre_execution_classification_clarificati.overall_rule: No majority vote and no scalar combination across channels. Report every channel separately for every history and width.
pre_execution_classification_clarificati.additive_identity: Checked componentwise before norms are formed.
